title: Images and files
lead: Browse, upload and organize public or private files without a database.

sections.title: Storage roots
body: Open Images → Overview and choose Public or Private storage. Public paths are constrained to public_html; private paths are constrained to system/storage/files.
Settings → Uploads selects a relative directory within each root. A blank value means that root itself. Absolute paths, traversal and symbolic links are rejected.

sections.title: Upload and organize
body: Choose the target folder, select a permitted file and upload it. Create subfolders to organize assets. Use the presented file address when inserting a public image into site content.
Public and private files use separate access rules. Private downloads require administration authentication. Validation checks file structure and content rather than trusting the extension alone.

sections.title: Trash and configuration
body: Removal uses soft-delete. Open Trash to restore files to their permitted origin when it is available.
Review Uploads settings before moving a storage root. Configuration changes do not silently relocate existing files or grant access outside the permitted roots.

sections.title: Public data boundaries
body: Images does not register a public Mustache content service or document source. Private files, upload listings, paths and administrative controls must not be exposed through editorial bindings.

Choose a public image in the authorized image picker or use its validated public URL in an img element. Blog/Slides/Page data can include their already-public image URLs. File-management routes remain protected independently of the shared renderer.
